note: Project engineering policy (spec §7.2). Not a NASA rule and not a universal theorem.

covariance.missing_data_rule: amplitude_modulated: scores of missing months are zero and stay at their calendar position; lags are calendar lags (Datta & Du 2012)
covariance.lag_policy: see aqua_trend.stats — fixed by the calibration study in backend/tests and recorded in docs/method-calibration.md

relative_change: only when the variable concept registers an approved denominator
stability_check: sign of the descriptive slope in the first and second half of the analysis period
